name: garmin-workouts
description: Describe a training session and create it in your own Garmin Connect account.
long_description: Install this extension, then say Connect my Garmin. The extension detects Chrome or downloads Chrome for Testing when needed, opens a dedicated Garmin sign-in window, and supports MFA. Passwords stay on Garmin's website. Create, inspect, update, delete and schedule running, cycling and swimming workouts. No terminal commands, API keys or JSON configuration are required. A graphical desktop is required for browser sign-in. This is an unofficial integration and is not affiliated with Garmin.

tools.name: connect_garmin
tools.description: Prepare the browser and connect your Garmin account.

tools.name: authenticate_garmin
tools.description: Start or resume Garmin browser sign-in.

tools.name: setup_garmin
tools.description: Prepare local storage and an optional browser download.

tools.name: disconnect_garmin
tools.description: Remove local credentials and the dedicated browser profile.

tools.name: schedule_garmin_workout
tools.description: Schedule a workout in the Garmin calendar.

prompts.name: garmin_setup
prompts.description: Connect Garmin and verify that workouts are ready.
prompts.text: Connect my Garmin account using connect_garmin, then check_garmin_auth. I will complete sign-in and MFA directly in Garmin's browser window. Once connected, tell me I can describe my workout.
